method: Step24-aligned event loop; matched streams and delay schedules

modes.FULL_PROTOCOL: Multiple pending blocks, immutable predictions, stale authority revoked
modes.SINGLE_PENDING: Drop a newly closed monitoring block if an older pending block exists
modes.NO_STALE_GUARD: Retain other pending windows after alarm; old windows may trigger later
modes.RECOMPUTED_HISTORY: Fault injection: recompute returned losses using current model

units: Run macro = mean across nonempty runs; pooled = total correct / total decisions
interpretation: Fault-injection controls are not valid competing algorithms
